review_method: All227 fresh480x854 native PNGs were inspected in26 call,21 other and11 island/external original-resolution2x2 sheets, with individual source checks recorded by each reviewer. Native image pixels are unmodified; sheets only arrange them. Every per-file review is bound to the exact source/tree/run and screenshot SHA-256.
bounded_findings: The20 long-name captures visibly ellipsize the fixture caller name to one line. The full contact name is therefore not visible on these call surfaces; number, timer and controls remain legible.

The Hebrew New call caption is ellipsized in the normal Emerald six-control grid at font1.3 and in its Hebrew long-name normal example. The handset-plus icon remains visible; the corresponding More panels show the full label.

At font1.3 the normal Emerald, Frost and Graphite captures show caller, number, timer and controls without a separate active-call caption. The standard counterparts include that caption; no overlap or lost primary control was seen.

Fixed dialpad FAB partly obscures one lower visible contact/recent-call control in several captured list positions, while upper row controls and the bottom navigation remain distinct. Screenshot review alone does not establish scrolling or tapping reachability; this is a bounded layout observation, not a claim that every visible control is unobscured.

Long contact/favorite names, recent-call date/time metadata, native notification headers and compact widget branding use ellipsis. Full visible phone numbers, principal state/count labels and action icons remain readable. Android CallStyle shortens the longer Hebrew speaker-on action.

Launcher-icon chooser is scrollable: the fifth icon is partial in the initial state and fully shown in the paired bottom state; the bottom state has a partial first row under its fixed header. Settings and list captures likewise include naturally partial adjacent rows at scroll edges.

Light avatar-shape chooser displays plain filled shapes without the initials present in the dark version. The four geometric previews, Hebrew labels, radio markers and Cancel action remain distinguishable.
Compact capsules intentionally ellipsize longer caller names; the expanded real-call capsule shows the complete two-line identity and readable timer/phase/actions.

At480x854/font1.3, expanded actualcontacts/recents leave roughly one visible list row; native tests require at least60dp of list area and preserve scrolling, query and anchors. The floating dial button is hidden in these constrained expanded views.

The inherited floating dial button in compact main lists can cover part of a lower-row call control at the pictured scroll position; the list can be scrolled to expose it. This is recorded rather than claiming that every list pixel remains uncovered.

Settings top/bottom images show the outer controls and nativebar contrast; permission/role, demo and style/size controls in the scroll middle are exercised by native assertions, and are not all pictured by these four settings captures.
